_comment: Copy this file to config.json (which is git-ignored) and fill in your own values. Any command-line option can go here, with underscores: e.g. --carto-key -> carto_key. You normally don't need lat/lon: the dashboard reads your receiver's location from its receiver.json. To set it by hand, rename _lat/_lon below to lat/lon.
subtitle: Live from the ADL rooftop
